info.title: The host words: the refusals, track kinds and feedback lines of the protocol's hosts

HOST_REPLY_CODES.description: The refusals the verbs of this package answer, by the number of resp <n>: mod-host's own numbers (mod-host.h) and the ones a worker answers past them.

oneOf.title: instanceInvalid
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_INSTANCE_INVALID: an instance number outside the host's table
oneOf.x-text: That instance number is not one of the host’s. Use an instance the host actually has.

oneOf.title: instanceAlreadyExists
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_INSTANCE_ALREADY_EXISTS: add asked for an instance number the host already has
oneOf.x-text: That instance number is already taken. Add the plugin under a number the host does not have yet.

oneOf.title: instanceNonExists
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_INSTANCE_NON_EXISTS: an instance no add made
oneOf.x-text: No add ever created that instance. Add it before using it.

oneOf.title: uriInvalid
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_LV2_INVALID_URI: add named a plugin the host does not find
oneOf.x-text: The host finds no plugin by that name. Check the plugin is installed and its name is spelt as the scan lists it.

oneOf.title: instantiationFailed
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_LV2_INSTANTIATION: the plugin refused to start
oneOf.x-text: The plugin was found but would not start. Try it again, or choose another plugin if it keeps refusing.

oneOf.title: paramSymbolInvalid
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_LV2_INVALID_PARAM_SYMBOL: a symbol that is not a parameter param_set takes, the plugin's own bypass included
oneOf.x-text: That symbol is not one of this plugin’s parameters, not even its bypass. Ask the plugin for its parameter list and use one of those symbols.

oneOf.title: presetUriInvalid
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_LV2_INVALID_PRESET_URI: a preset this plugin does not have, or a file it cannot take
oneOf.x-text: That preset is not one this plugin can load. Choose a preset from the plugin’s own list.

oneOf.title: stateLoadFailed
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_LV2_CANT_LOAD_STATE: the plugin refused its saved state
oneOf.x-text: The plugin would not take its saved state back. Load another preset, or set its values again.

oneOf.title: jackClientCreation
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_CLIENT_CREATION: no audio client could be made for the plugin
oneOf.x-text: The host could not connect the plugin to the audio server. Check the audio server is running, then add the plugin again.

oneOf.title: jackClientActivation
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_CLIENT_ACTIVATION: the plugin's audio client would not start
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s audio connection would not start. Check the audio server is running, then add the plugin again.

oneOf.title: jackClientDeactivation
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_CLIENT_DEACTIVATION: the plugin's audio client would not stop
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s audio connection would not stop. Remove the plugin, or restart the audio server if it stays.

oneOf.title: jackPortRegister
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_PORT_REGISTER: a port of the plugin could not be made
oneOf.x-text: The host could not make one of the plugin’s audio ports. Remove some plugins, then add this one again.

oneOf.title: jackPortConnection
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_PORT_CONNECTION: two ports could not be connected
oneOf.x-text: Those two ports could not be connected. Check both ports exist and carry the same kind of signal.

oneOf.title: jackPortDisconnection
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_PORT_DISCONNECTION: two ports could not be disconnected
oneOf.x-text: Those two ports could not be disconnected. Check they are connected to each other.

oneOf.title: valueOutOfRange
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_JACK_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: a tempo or a beats-per-bar the transport does not take
oneOf.x-text: That tempo or beats per bar is outside what the host accepts. Choose a value within the host’s range.

oneOf.title: externalUiUnavailable
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_EXTERNAL_UI_UNAVAILABLE: the plugin has no window of its own to show
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has no window of its own to show. Use the host’s controls for it instead.

oneOf.title: memoryAllocation
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_MEMORY_ALLOCATION: the reply could not be built
oneOf.x-text: The host ran out of memory while building the reply. Try again once memory is free.

oneOf.title: invalidOperation
oneOf.description: mod-host's ERR_INVALID_OPERATION: a word outside the verb's grammar, or a verb the host refuses on purpose
oneOf.x-text: That word is not part of this verb, or the host refuses it on purpose. Check the verb’s grammar and send a word it accepts.

oneOf.title: pinAbsent
oneOf.description: a layout pin in a scheme this host does not know, refused as no pin at all
oneOf.x-text: This host does not know that layout pin’s scheme, so it is refused as if no pin had been sent. Send a pin in a scheme this host knows.

oneOf.title: pinLayoutMismatch
oneOf.description: the add of an instance whose layout after init is not the one pin_expect named: the plugin is not activated
oneOf.x-text: After it started, the plugin’s layout did not match the pin you expected, so it was not activated. Expect the layout the plugin actually has, or use a plugin built to that pin.

oneOf.title: noParamContract
oneOf.description: the host holds no checked unit and scale for this parameter: the controller falls back to the layout the scan gives
oneOf.x-text: The host has no checked unit or scale for this parameter. Fall back to the layout the scan gave.

oneOf.title: noNoteInput
oneOf.description: the instance's plugin takes no notes
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s instance takes no notes. Don’t send it note events.

oneOf.title: notesByJack
oneOf.description: the instance's worker takes no notes on its socket (mod-host): the plugin is played through its jack MIDI input
oneOf.x-text: This instance’s worker takes no notes on its socket; play it through its jack MIDI input instead.

oneOf.title: noteQueueFull
oneOf.description: the worker has no room for the line's notes before its next block: nothing of it is kept, and the line may be sent again
oneOf.x-text: The worker had no room for these notes before its next block, so none of them were kept. Send the line again.

oneOf.title: propertySymbolInvalid
oneOf.description: a symbol that is not one of the instance's file or text properties (org.openmixer.properties/1), or an index past its last
oneOf.x-text: That symbol is not one of this plugin’s file or text properties. Ask the plugin for its property list and use one of those symbols.

oneOf.title: propertyAccess
oneOf.description: a set of a property that is not writable, or a get of one that is not readable
oneOf.x-text: This property cannot be used that way: it is not writable, or not readable. Check the property's access before setting or reading it.

oneOf.title: propertyValueInvalid
oneOf.description: a property value the host does not hand on: larger than OMX_CLAP_PROPERTY_VALUE_MAX with its NUL, not UTF-8, or a path that is not absolute
oneOf.x-text: That value cannot be set: it is too long, not valid text, or a path that does not start with a slash. Send a shorter value, or an absolute path.

oneOf.title: propertyQueueFull
oneOf.description: the instance's property ring has no room before its next block: nothing of the set is kept, and it may be sent again
oneOf.x-text: The plugin had no room for this value before its next block, so it was not kept. Send it again.

HOST_TRACK_KINDS.description: The kind of strip, the last word of track_info; a line without it is an input channel.

HOST_EVENTS.description: The lines a host writes on its feedback port for these verbs, each followed by the instance number, but xruns, which is the worker's own and is followed by its count.

oneOf.title: remotePagesChanged
oneOf.description: the plugin changed its remote pages: a controller reads remote_pages and remote_page_get again

oneOf.title: xruns
oneOf.description: the worker's JACK xrun count since its start, written when it changes and at most once a second; a worker that never writes it reports no xruns

oneOf.title: abiClobber
oneOf.description: the plugin returned from a call with a callee-saved register changed (0.26.2): the instance number, the registers as a hexadecimal mask with their names, the plugin function and the block, written once per instance. The worker put the registers back, so its own frame is whole; the other members' state in the same process is not covered, so the plugin is run only in a worker of its own
